groupTitle: Group (click the frame background to focus the group; drag to move the whole group; drag the actions inside to reorder within the group)
repeatTitle: Group count (the actions inside are done this many times in a row)
ungroupTitle: Ungroup (keeps the current count; the actions inside become normal actions repeated that many times)
insertBeforeGroup: Adds before the focused group (× {{count}}), outside the group
insertAtEnd: Adds at the end of this stint (select an action or group to add before it)
insertAtStart: Adds at the start of the stint (right after the switch)
insertJoinsGroup: (The selected action is inside a group, so the added action joins the group)
title: Build area
clearConfirm: Clear all stints and actions? (the team is kept)
clearAllTitle: Keep the team's characters, but clear all stints and actions on the timeline
addStintBefore: Add a stint for {{name}} before the focused stint (#{{index}})
addStintEnd: Add a stint for {{name}} at the end (focus a stint to add before it)
quickReorderHint: (drag the chips to change the order)
guideToggleTitle: Show or hide the action legend and tips
chipFocusTitle: Focus {{name}}'s stint (does not select actions; highlighted on the Gantt chart and settings)
legendHE: Hold Skill (tE: tap for characters with a hold skill, rE: recast)
legendN: Normal Attack (consecutive N are counted as hit 1, hit 2, … automatically)
hint: Click an action (E / Q / Normal, etc.) on the Gantt chart to jump to that character's stint card with the action selected. Actions can also be reordered by dragging directly on the Gantt chart. Ctrl+click adjacent actions to select several and turn them into a group with a count.
focusStintTitle: Focus this stint (does not select actions; highlighted on the Gantt chart and settings)
upTitle: Move this character's stint one earlier (up)
downTitle: Move this character's stint one later (down)
toGanttTitle: Jump to this stint's row on the Gantt chart
modeHoldTitle:
[Mode hold] Automatically extends the time after the stint's last action so that "{{mode}}" lasts its maximum duration (the extension is not saved; it is written as wait in the gcsim config).
When off, the switch happens right after the last action. To end it early, place an action that ends it.
addTitle: Add actions (inserted before the selected action or group; each button's tooltip shows the insert position)
groupNeedAdjacent: Select adjacent actions that are not already in a group
groupOneTitle: Turn the selected action into a repeating group (set the count after creating it; the notation looks like 3C)
groupManyTitle: Turn the selected actions into one group (you can set a count)
waitTitle: Wait (do nothing for {{seconds}} s; change the length in the action time field of the added action)
delayTitle:
[Delay after this action]: +{{seconds}}s
A gap inserted after this action ends (▲▼ changes it by 0.05 s).
swapTitle:
[Switch time (start of the stint)]
Time: {{duration}}s
Period: [{{start}}s – {{end}}s] (click to focus)
specialChargedTitle: Special Charged Attack: uses 1 special skill charge (no stamina). If no charge is available, it becomes a normal Charged Attack
motionTitle: Action time (type it, or ▲▼ in 0.1 s steps; hold to repeat)
effectTitle:
Effect duration: {{label}} (default {{seconds}}s)
Shown as an effect bar on the Gantt chart (0s hides it)
switchDelayHint: Sets the lockout and internal switch cooldown when switching characters (default 0.50 s). Applied automatically between all stints.
actionDelayHint: Sets input lag and buffering delay per action (default 0.10 s; change individually with "+0.10s" to the right of each action below).
setAllTitle: Set the delay of all actions to {{seconds}} s
defHaltHint: On: enemies whose poise does not break (large bosses, etc.); attack hitlag is 0.06 s longer per hit. Off: enemies whose poise breaks (small enemies); passes `defhalt=false` to gcsim. Also applied to automatic action times (the part extended by hitlag, from gcsim measurements) and to extending the window of Storm of Swords.
hurtHint: When on, the on-field character takes physical damage at intervals in gcsim (both interval and amount are random within the range). Reproduces effects that require losing HP from damage taken, such as Dehya's "Crimson Blood". When off, no damage is taken. The app's calculation does not change.
hurtInvalid: Invalid values (min ≤ max, at least 1). Not passed to gcsim
